SELECT JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'reference_sample_id') AS reference_sample_id, r.sample_id AS sample_id, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'part_key') AS part_key, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'part_number') AS part_number, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'part_type') AS part_type, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'part_description') AS part_description, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'subspecialty') AS subspecialty, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'block_key') AS block_key, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'block_number') AS block_number, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'block_label') AS block_label, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'slide_key') AS slide_key, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'stain_name') AS stain_name, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'stain_group') AS stain_group, JSONExtractBool(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'is_hne') AS is_hne, JSONExtractBool(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'is_ihc') AS is_ihc, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'magnification') AS magnification, JSONExtract(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'file_size_bytes', 'Nullable(UInt64)') AS file_size_bytes, JSONExtractBool(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'can_serve_tiles') AS can_serve_tiles, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'slide_type') AS slide_type, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'match_level') AS match_level, JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.metadata, '{}'), 'specimen_key') AS specimen_key FROM resource_data r PREWHERE r.cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND r.patient_id = #{patientId} WHERE r.resource_id IN ('WSI_SAMPLE', 'WSI_PATIENT') AND r.type = 'WHOLE_SLIDE_IMAGE'
ORDER BY ifNull(sample_id, ''), toUInt32OrNull(part_number) NULLS LAST, part_key, toUInt32OrNull(block_number) NULLS LAST, block_key, slide_key
